parameters.subject: ✅ Conditional Approval - Final Steps for Your Mortgage
📊 Update: Your Application is in Underwriting
parameters.message:
Hi {{$node['Get Lead from Twenty CRM'].json.name}},

📊 Application Update: Your mortgage is now in underwriting review!

🔍 What's Happening:
Our underwriting team is carefully reviewing your application and supporting documents. This is a normal part of the approval process.

⏰ Expected Timeline:
- Underwriting review: 3-5 business days
- Initial decision: {{$json.expectedDecisionDate}}
- Potential outcome: {{$json.expectedOutcome}}

📋 Your Application:
Loan Amount: ${{$node['Get Lead from Twenty CRM'].json.customFields.loanAmount | number:0}}
Program: {{$json.loanProgram}}
Submitted: {{$json.submissionDate}}
Underwriter: {{$json.assignedUnderwriter}}

📊 Review Process:
✅ Income verification
✅ Asset verification
✅ Credit analysis
🔄 Property appraisal (in progress)
🔄 Final risk assessment

💬 What to Expect:
- We may request additional documentation
- Appraisal will be ordered (if not already complete)
- You'll receive updates at each milestone
- Your loan officer remains available for questions

📞 Stay Connected:
Loan Officer: {{$node['Get Lead from Twenty CRM'].json.assignedLoanOfficer}}
Underwriting Questions: (555) 123-UNDER
Status Updates: Text NYRA to 12345

🎯 Next Steps:
- Keep your phone handy (we may need quick responses)
- Don't make major purchases or change jobs
- Respond quickly to any requests for additional info

We're working hard to get you approved!

Best regards,
Nyra Underwriting Team
